categories.name: Admission to Normal Care
categories.description: Patient is admitted to a normal care inpatient ward (Admission NC), advancing the organization's valued goals while balancing resource constraints. Performance is judged against the post-discharge ER return indicator.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=15 (Admission NC) under Goal id=5 (Patient is admitted to an inpatient ward, OR-decomposed).

categories.name: Admission to Intensive Care
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an intensive care inpatient ward (Admission IC). This alternative carries a negative contribution to minimizing time-to-treatment (-25) and is judged against post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=16 (Admission IC) under Goal id=5 (Patient is admitted to an inpatient ward, OR-decomposed).
